_source: Dead by Daylight Wiki 'Terror Radius' (deadbydaylight.wiki.gg), accessed 2026-11-08; Mastermind 40 m per PCGamesN (patch 6.2.0).

layers.description: Layers 1, 2 and 3 divide the Terror Radius into three equidistant radii: layer 1 = far third, layer 2 = middle third, layer 3 = near third. In a chase, layer 4 (chase music) replaces layer 3. Layers 5-6 are chase embellishments.

heartbeat.description: Heartbeat SFX loudness and pace increase with proximity. The in-game Visual Terror Radius (Settings > Accessibility, off by default) draws a beating heart in the survivor's chest, in sync with the heartbeat; colour-blind modes recolour it; lullabies show as a non-graded haze.
heartbeat._bpm_note: Unknown - measure from a recorded KYF/custom session (docs/AUDIO_HEARTBEAT.md) and fill in.

_caveat: Perks, add-ons, powers, Undetectable and Oblivious change or remove the Terror Radius. The ring is only ever as good as what the player can hear.
